findings.issue: The contract, plan and prompt 72 all require `reference/web/src/app/core/reference-web-i18n.service.ts` to import the angular-ui catalogs as `@stynx-nyx/angular-ui/catalogs/*.json`. The Playwright spa-only web server builds the app with `pnpm build:web`, which runs `reference/web/scripts/build-web.mjs`. That esbuild config aliases `'@stynx-nyx/angular-ui'` to `packages-web/angular-ui/src/index.ts`, and esbuild also applies the alias to subpaths. I ran that esbuild config in memory, without writing files: the import resolves to `packages-web/angular-ui/src/index.ts/catalogs/en.json` and fails with `Could not resolve`. The locked Engineer route and i18n edits would therefore break the build, the smoke shell spec, and the required gate `pnpm --filter @stynx-nyx/reference-web test:e2e --project spa-only`. The fix touches `build-web.mjs`, which is in no role lock. The same in-memory probe resolves once a more specific alias is added, e.g. `'@stynx-nyx/angular-ui/catalogs': <workspace>/packages-web/angular-ui/src/i18n`. `reference/web/test/unit/reference-web-config.spec.mjs` only checks that a `'<dep>':` alias key exists, so an added alias key keeps that test passing.

findings.issue: The reference app uses locale keys `en-US` and `pt-BR`, but angular-ui ships `en.json` and `pt-BR.json`. Separately, esbuild bundles from source aliases, so the Playwright page renders source catalogs, not the dist copies. Only `tsc` resolves the published export.

summary: All three cycle-2 blockers are repaired, and I checked each against the source. (1) `smoke/**/*.spec.ts` is already in the spa-only `ownedCategorySpecs` and in the gate's `requiredCategories`. Both frozen files stay outside every lock, and the spec must call axe directly and fail on serious/critical violations and on scan errors, which the existing `scanA11y` only records. (2) The extractor's `ui` namespace rule for angular-ui collects literal `ui.error.*` and `ui.shell.*` strings. `packages-web/angular` has namespace `angular`, so the classifier's `ui.error.*` literals there create no stale keys. `keys.json` is inside Engineer B's `src/**` lock, and `pnpm i18n:extract && pnpm i18n:check` is required. (3) Engineer A owns `error-classification.ts` and `packages-web/angular/src/index.ts`. The cycle-2 nonblocking items are all resolved: requestId comes from CLS or the response header (no phantom `request.requestId`), omitting the optional `retryable` is stated as a choice, the `_VALIDATION_ERROR` suffix applies only to the `unknown` row (418 → validation, 403 → authorization), and the Docker compose and built `reference/api` prerequisites are documented. The exact route and i18n files are locked. The cycle-1 repairs still hold against the source. The DETRAN §6.3–6.6 test obligations and the OD-S15-01 MUST scope are covered. Backend tests can use `StynxCoreModule` through the existing vitest alias without a new manifest dependency. One blocking gap remains: the locked published-catalog import cannot build under `reference/web/scripts/build-web.mjs`, whose angular-ui alias sends the subpath to `src/index.ts/catalogs/en.json`. That file is in no lock. Adding it to the root Engineer lock with a subpath alias is a small repair. After that, and with the predecessor integration table filled, Inspector dispatch would be safe.
